# Draft Outreach - Character Artist Or Studio

**Status: DRAFT ONLY. DO NOT SEND WITHOUT OWNER APPROVAL.**

Subject: Trap Wars Unity Hero + Ray character package and paid evaluation request

Hello,

We are producing a focused Day 1 investor-demo vertical slice for **Trap Wars**, a grounded contemporary strategy/economy game combining premium financial-product discipline with hip-hop/street editorial confidence. We need two coherent lead characters: the player Hero and Ray, an experienced neighborhood contact.

The target is grounded semi-realism, believable adult anatomy, original contemporary fashion, expressive faces, and strong differentiation. We are avoiding cartoon proportions, cyberpunk/fantasy, generic marketplace “urban” styling, gang stereotypes, visible brands, and celebrity likenesses.

Technical target:

- Unity 6000.3.20f1, URP 17.3, valid Humanoid FBX, clean T/A pose/hierarchy/bind/scale.
- 1.82 m presentation target; 45k-80k triangles at LOD0, LOD1 near 50%, LOD2 near 20%.
- Maximum four skinned renderers preferred, up to twelve materials, 2K skin/head/outfit maps and 1K accessories.
- Required facial capability includes blink, jaw/mouth, smile/frown, brows, Ray skepticism/concern, and a reusable English viseme set or documented equivalent.
- Hero should support future clothing/shoe/jewelry/hair swaps and portrait-quality rendering.
- Appropriate editable source files and a full dependency/delivery manifest are requested.

Before a full commission, we would like to discuss a **paid evaluation milestone** where practical: one production-candidate Hero, one Ray, textures/rig/facial samples, and permission to test privately in our Unity neutral/Day/Night evaluation scene. We do not expect unpaid custom production.

Please provide:

1. Relevant grounded character, fashion, facial, and Unity/game portfolio examples.
2. Recommended base/custom workflow and what is original versus third-party.
3. Scope, exclusions, milestone schedule, cost class/custom quote, and payment structure.
4. Included revision rounds, review windows, and change-order policy.
5. Runtime and editable source-file delivery list.
6. Commercial game, investor-demo, marketing/trailer/social, modification, update, and platform rights; ownership/exclusivity/portfolio terms; redistribution and sublicensing limits.
7. All third-party assets/tools/licenses and any generative-AI use or training-data provenance relevant to the delivery.
8. Earliest paid evaluation and final-delivery timing.

Detailed Hero, Ray, facial, and visual-reference briefs are available for proposal review. No quote or commission is accepted until owner approval and contract/license review.

Thank you.
